description: Ministry of Water Supply - Meegaha Ela, Ganewatta D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a public project. It specifically authorizes the acquisition of immobile properties (land) described in a detailed schedule for the construction of a water tower. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, location details, and the name of the land claimant, which are all characteristic of Land Gazettes (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, the core subject matter is land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
